purpose: Final Hero closure sweep across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, with a visual-scale contract for wide desktops and explicit 2026 Apple geometry probes. Frozen phone/tablet/foldable production CSS remains outside the wide-desktop candidate scope.
notes: Exhaustive union of every current phone/tablet/foldable QA family case plus the full desktop matrix. Generated from current contracts/TestMU registry for final closure; IDs are family-prefixed to keep Chromium baselines unambiguous.

wideDesktopScale.note: Required scale = min(maxScale, width/1920, (height/1080)*1.215), with a small tolerance. This intentionally catches layouts that are collision-free but visually underscaled. V3 also enforces absolute wide-desktop floors so the first post-1920 cases cannot pass while remaining visually laptop-sized.

wideDesktopShell.note: The Hero-only shell should use nearly all available width until the height-aware composition cap is reached. This catches the excessive side void that V1 allowed at 3440px+.

wideDesktopContact.note: The contact SVG already scales from its 200x200 viewBox. Its internal text and arrow must not receive a second full viewport scale.
